+# Floating Element System
+
+## Overview
+
+The floating element system positions DOM elements (toolbars, textareas, panels) relative to Konva canvas objects. It handles coordinate transformation between Konva's canvas coordinate system and the browser's DOM coordinate system, accounting for canvas pan, zoom, object transforms, and real-time drag/resize operations.
+
+## Component Inventory
+
+| Component                     | Path                                                            | Responsibility                                             |
+| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
+| FloatingQuickActions          | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingQuickActions.tsx`          | Action toolbar above a selected image/video                |
+| FloatingFrameActions          | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingFrameActions.tsx`          | Action toolbar above a selected frame                      |
+| FloatingTextareaContainer     | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingTextareaContainer.tsx`     | Text-to-image prompt input below a placeholder image       |
+| FloatingAIEditContainer       | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingAIEditContainer.tsx`       | AI Edit prompt input below a non-placeholder image         |
+| FloatingRemoveObjectContainer | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingRemoveObjectContainer.tsx` | Remove Object prompt input below a non-placeholder image   |
+| FloatingExpandContainer       | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingExpandContainer.tsx`       | Expand prompt input with aspect ratio and padding controls |
+| FloatingMultiImageActions     | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingMultiImageActions.tsx`     | Action toolbar above a multi-image selection group         |
+| FloatingRemixContainer        | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingRemixContainer.tsx`        | Remix prompt input below a multi-image selection group     |
+| FloatingTextarea              | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingTextarea.tsx`              | Shared presentational textarea with 5 variants             |
+| FrameExportPanel              | `/components/canvas/floating/FrameExportPanel.tsx`              | Sheet modal for frame export options                       |
+| QuickActionButton             | `/components/canvas/floating/QuickActionButton.tsx`             | Reusable styled button for action toolbars                 |
+
+## Positioning Infrastructure
+
+| File                                         | Exports                                                                                                                                                                               |
+| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `/utils/canvas/floating-element-position.ts` | `canvasToScreen`, `screenToCanvas`, `getObjectBounds`, `getImageBounds`, `getPanelBounds`, `getAnchorPoint`, `calculateFloatingPosition`, `getCenteringTransform`, `FLOATING_PRESETS` |
+| `/hooks/use-floating-element-position.ts`    | `useFloatingElementPosition` hook, re-exports `FLOATING_PRESETS`, `AnchorPosition`, `AnchorOffset` types                                                                              |
+
+The hook accepts a `containerRef`, a `getTargetObject` callback, and optional `anchor` / `offset` parameters. It returns `updatePosition()` and `updatePositionForObject()` functions that apply CSS `left`/`top` directly to the DOM element for performance. The hook does not subscribe to any stores — the consuming component handles subscriptions.
+
+**Defaults:** anchor `bottom-center`, offset `{ x: 0, y: 12 }`.
+
+## How It Works
+
+### Anchor Points
+
+Floating elements can be anchored to 9 positions around an object:
+
+| Row    | Left        | Center        | Right        |
+| ------ | ----------- | ------------- | ------------ |
+| Top    | top-left    | top-center    | top-right    |
+| Middle | middle-left | center        | middle-right |
+| Bottom | bottom-left | bottom-center | bottom-right |
+
+The CSS `transform` for centering depends on the anchor:
+
+| Anchor                        | CSS Transform           |
+| ----------------------------- | ----------------------- |
+| `top-center`, `bottom-center` | `translateX(-50%)`      |
+| `middle-left`, `middle-right` | `translateY(-50%)`      |
+| `center`                      | `translate(-50%, -50%)` |
+| Corner anchors                | None needed             |
+
+Use `getCenteringTransform(anchor)` to compute the correct value.
+
+### Presets
+
+| Preset          | Anchor          | Offset             |
+| --------------- | --------------- | ------------------ |
+| `toolbarAbove`  | `top-center`    | `{ x: 0, y: -12 }` |
+| `textareaBelow` | `bottom-center` | `{ x: 0, y: 12 }`  |
+| `actionsRight`  | `middle-right`  | `{ x: 12, y: 0 }`  |
+| `infoLeft`      | `middle-left`   | `{ x: -12, y: 0 }` |
+
+### Two Positioning Strategies
+
+**1. Hook-based (single object):** Six components use `useFloatingElementPosition` to track a single canvas object. They subscribe to `useCanvasTransformStore` for pan/zoom and `useImageDragStore` for real-time drag updates.
+
+**2. Bounds-based (multi-selection):** `FloatingMultiImageActions` and `FloatingRemixContainer` use `useMultiSelectBounds` and `canvasToScreenCoordinates` directly, because they must track the bounding box of multiple selected objects rather than a single object.
+
+### Component Anchor Configuration
+
+| Component                     | Anchor          | Offset             | Strategy     |
+| ----------------------------- | --------------- | ------------------ | ------------ |
+| FloatingQuickActions          | `top-center`    | `{ x: 0, y: -40 }` | Hook         |
+| FloatingFrameActions          | `top-center`    | `{ x: 0, y: -40 }` | Hook         |
+| FloatingTextareaContainer     | `bottom-center` | `{ x: 0, y: 12 }`  | Hook         |
+| FloatingAIEditContainer       | `bottom-center` | `{ x: 0, y: 12 }`  | Hook         |
+| FloatingRemoveObjectContainer | `bottom-center` | `{ x: 0, y: 12 }`  | Hook         |
+| FloatingExpandContainer       | `bottom-center` | `{ x: 0, y: 12 }`  | Hook         |
+| FloatingMultiImageActions     | top-center      | 16px above group   | Bounds-based |
+| FloatingRemixContainer        | bottom-center   | 8px below group    | Bounds-based |
+
+### Visibility Rules
+
+Each component controls its own visibility:
+
+| Component                     | Visible When                                                                 |
+| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| FloatingQuickActions          | Single non-frame, non-locked selection; not read-only; not video placeholder |
+| FloatingFrameActions          | Single frame selection; not read-only; not locked                            |
+| FloatingTextareaContainer     | Single placeholder image selected; not currently generating                  |
+| FloatingAIEditContainer       | Panel open; image exists; image is NOT a placeholder                         |
+| FloatingRemoveObjectContainer | Panel open; image exists; image is NOT a placeholder                         |
+| FloatingExpandContainer       | Panel open; image exists; image is NOT a placeholder                         |
+| FloatingMultiImageActions     | 2+ images selected; bounds available; stage exists                           |
+| FloatingRemixContainer        | Panel open; 2+ images selected                                               |
+
+### FloatingTextarea Variants
+
+The `FloatingTextarea` presentational component supports 5 variants, each exposing different controls:
+
+| Variant         | Used By                       | Controls                                                           |
+| --------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
+| `generate`      | FloatingTextareaContainer     | Base model selector, aspect ratio, reference images, auto-complete |
+| `ai-edit`       | FloatingAIEditContainer       | AI model selector (Gemini / OpenAI)                                |
+| `remove-object` | FloatingRemoveObjectContainer | Minimal (prompt only)                                              |
+| `expand`        | FloatingExpandContainer       | Aspect ratio selector                                              |
+| `remix`         | FloatingRemixContainer        | Remix model selector, selected images preview grid                 |
+
+### Update Pattern
+
+All hook-based floating components follow the same pattern:
+
+1. Create a `containerRef` via `useRef`
+2. Call `useFloatingElementPosition` with `containerRef` and `getTargetObject`
+3. Subscribe to `useCanvasTransformStore` (position, scale) — call `updatePosition()` on change
+4. Subscribe to `useImageDragStore` (dragPosition, dragDimensions, dragScale) — call `updatePositionForObject()` with temporary drag state during drag
+5. Call `updatePositionForObject()` when object properties change after drag ends
+
+Toolbars (FloatingQuickActions, FloatingFrameActions) reduce opacity to 50% while their target object is being dragged.
+
+## Test Coverage
+
+| Test File                                                                     | Type | Coverage Area                                                                      |
+| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `tests/unit/utils/floating-textarea-position.test.ts`                         | Unit | canvasToScreen, screenToCanvas, calculateFloatingPosition, getImageBounds, presets |
+| `tests/unit/components/canvas/floating/FloatingQuickActions.test.tsx`         | Unit | Quick action toolbar behavior                                                      |
+| `tests/unit/components/canvas/floating/FloatingFrameActions-publish.test.tsx` | Unit | Frame actions publish flow                                                         |
+| `tests/unit/components/canvas/floating-textarea-container.test.tsx`           | Unit | Textarea container behavior                                                        |
+| `tests/unit/components/canvas/floating-textarea-buttons.test.tsx`             | Unit | Textarea button interactions                                                       |
+| `tests/unit/components/canvas/floating-textarea-excess-images.test.tsx`       | Unit | Reference image excess handling                                                    |

+# Floating Element System
+
+## Overview
+
+The floating element system positions DOM elements (toolbars, textareas, panels) relative to Konva canvas objects. It handles coordinate transformation between Konva's canvas coordinate system and the browser's DOM coordinate system, accounting for canvas pan, zoom, object transforms, and real-time drag/resize operations.
+
+## Component Inventory
+
+| Component                     | Path                                                            | Responsibility                                             |
+| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
+| FloatingQuickActions          | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingQuickActions.tsx`          | Action toolbar above a selected image/video                |
+| FloatingFrameActions          | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingFrameActions.tsx`          | Action toolbar above a selected frame                      |
+| FloatingTextareaContainer     | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingTextareaContainer.tsx`     | Text-to-image prompt input below a placeholder image       |
+| FloatingAIEditContainer       | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingAIEditContainer.tsx`       | AI Edit prompt input below a non-placeholder image         |
+| FloatingRemoveObjectContainer | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingRemoveObjectContainer.tsx` | Remove Object prompt input below a non-placeholder image   |
+| FloatingExpandContainer       | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingExpandContainer.tsx`       | Expand prompt input with aspect ratio and padding controls |
+| FloatingMultiImageActions     | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingMultiImageActions.tsx`     | Action toolbar above a multi-image selection group         |
+| FloatingRemixContainer        | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingRemixContainer.tsx`        | Remix prompt input below a multi-image selection group     |
+| FloatingTextarea              | `/components/canvas/floating/FloatingTextarea.tsx`              | Shared presentational textarea with 5 variants             |
+| FrameExportPanel              | `/components/canvas/floating/FrameExportPanel.tsx`              | Sheet modal for frame export options                       |
+| QuickActionButton             | `/components/canvas/floating/QuickActionButton.tsx`             | Reusable styled button for action toolbars                 |
+
+## Positioning Infrastructure
+
+| File                                         | Exports                                                                                                                                                                               |
+| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `/utils/canvas/floating-element-position.ts` | `canvasToScreen`, `screenToCanvas`, `getObjectBounds`, `getImageBounds`, `getPanelBounds`, `getAnchorPoint`, `calculateFloatingPosition`, `getCenteringTransform`, `FLOATING_PRESETS` |
+| `/hooks/use-floating-element-position.ts`    | `useFloatingElementPosition` hook, re-exports `FLOATING_PRESETS`, `AnchorPosition`, `AnchorOffset` types                                                                              |
+
+The hook accepts a `containerRef`, a `getTargetObject` callback, and optional `anchor` / `offset` parameters. It returns `updatePosition()` and `updatePositionForObject()` functions that apply CSS `left`/`top` directly to the DOM element for performance. The hook does not subscribe to any stores — the consuming component handles subscriptions.
+
+**Defaults:** anchor `bottom-center`, offset `{ x: 0, y: 12 }`.
+
+## How It Works
+
+### Anchor Points
+
+Floating elements can be anchored to 9 positions around an object:
+
+| Row    | Left        | Center        | Right        |
+| ------ | ----------- | ------------- | ------------ |
+| Top    | top-left    | top-center    | top-right    |
+| Middle | middle-left | center        | middle-right |
+| Bottom | bottom-left | bottom-center | bottom-right |
+
+The CSS `transform` for centering depends on the anchor:
+
+| Anchor                        | CSS Transform           |
+| ----------------------------- | ----------------------- |
+| `top-center`, `bottom-center` | `translateX(-50%)`      |
+| `middle-left`, `middle-right` | `translateY(-50%)`      |
+| `center`                      | `translate(-50%, -50%)` |
+| Corner anchors                | None needed             |
+
+Use `getCenteringTransform(anchor)` to compute the correct value.
+
+### Presets
+
+| Preset          | Anchor          | Offset             |
+| --------------- | --------------- | ------------------ |
+| `toolbarAbove`  | `top-center`    | `{ x: 0, y: -12 }` |
+| `textareaBelow` | `bottom-center` | `{ x: 0, y: 12 }`  |
+| `actionsRight`  | `middle-right`  | `{ x: 12, y: 0 }`  |
+| `infoLeft`      | `middle-left`   | `{ x: -12, y: 0 }` |
+
+### Two Positioning Strategies
+
+**1. Hook-based (single object):** Six components use `useFloatingElementPosition` to track a single canvas object. They subscribe to `useCanvasTransformStore` for pan/zoom and `useImageDragStore` for real-time drag updates.
+
+**2. Bounds-based (multi-selection):** `FloatingMultiImageActions` and `FloatingRemixContainer` use `useMultiSelectBounds` and `canvasToScreenCoordinates` directly, because they must track the bounding box of multiple selected objects rather than a single object.
+
+### Component Anchor Configuration
+
+| Component                     | Anchor          | Offset             | Strategy     |
+| ----------------------------- | --------------- | ------------------ | ------------ |
+| FloatingQuickActions          | `top-center`    | `{ x: 0, y: -40 }` | Hook         |
+| FloatingFrameActions          | `top-center`    | `{ x: 0, y: -40 }` | Hook         |
+| FloatingTextareaContainer     | `bottom-center` | `{ x: 0, y: 12 }`  | Hook         |
+| FloatingAIEditContainer       | `bottom-center` | `{ x: 0, y: 12 }`  | Hook         |
+| FloatingRemoveObjectContainer | `bottom-center` | `{ x: 0, y: 12 }`  | Hook         |
+| FloatingExpandContainer       | `bottom-center` | `{ x: 0, y: 12 }`  | Hook         |
+| FloatingMultiImageActions     | top-center      | 16px above group   | Bounds-based |
+| FloatingRemixContainer        | bottom-center   | 8px below group    | Bounds-based |
+
+### Visibility Rules
+
+Each component controls its own visibility:
+
+| Component                     | Visible When                                                                 |
+| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| FloatingQuickActions          | Single non-frame, non-locked selection; not read-only; not video placeholder |
+| FloatingFrameActions          | Single frame selection; not read-only; not locked                            |
+| FloatingTextareaContainer     | Single placeholder image selected; not currently generating                  |
+| FloatingAIEditContainer       | Panel open; image exists; image is NOT a placeholder                         |
+| FloatingRemoveObjectContainer | Panel open; image exists; image is NOT a placeholder                         |
+| FloatingExpandContainer       | Panel open; image exists; image is NOT a placeholder                         |
+| FloatingMultiImageActions     | 2+ images selected; bounds available; stage exists                           |
+| FloatingRemixContainer        | Panel open; 2+ images selected                                               |
+
+### FloatingTextarea Variants
+
+The `FloatingTextarea` presentational component supports 5 variants, each exposing different controls:
+
+| Variant         | Used By                       | Controls                                                           |
+| --------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
+| `generate`      | FloatingTextareaContainer     | Base model selector, aspect ratio, reference images, auto-complete |
+| `ai-edit`       | FloatingAIEditContainer       | AI model selector (Gemini / OpenAI)                                |
+| `remove-object` | FloatingRemoveObjectContainer | Minimal (prompt only)                                              |
+| `expand`        | FloatingExpandContainer       | Aspect ratio selector                                              |
+| `remix`         | FloatingRemixContainer        | Remix model selector, selected images preview grid                 |
+
+### Update Pattern
+
+All hook-based floating components follow the same pattern:
+
+1. Create a `containerRef` via `useRef`
+2. Call `useFloatingElementPosition` with `containerRef` and `getTargetObject`
+3. Subscribe to `useCanvasTransformStore` (position, scale) — call `updatePosition()` on change
+4. Subscribe to `useImageDragStore` (dragPosition, dragDimensions, dragScale) — call `updatePositionForObject()` with temporary drag state during drag
+5. Call `updatePositionForObject()` when object properties change after drag ends
+
+Toolbars (FloatingQuickActions, FloatingFrameActions) reduce opacity to 50% while their target object is being dragged.
